description: Reproduction of exp100 using TinyMultiHeadLut's built-in sparse_scatter mode (refactor) instead of MultiHeadLut + external SparseScatter wrapper. Drops MultiHeadLut's n_alternatives=3 and smooth_mode=True (those defaults came from CIFAR-10 memory note, wrong context). Tiny path uses its own STE-with-carriers gradient and the int16 lookup. Same architecture as exp100: E=384, d_qk=32, d_v=64, classic skip residual, linear unembedder, all three LUTs (qk_joint, v_lut, out_proj) sparse-scatter at nap=8, qk/v tph=384 n_sparse=8, out tph=2048 n_sparse=8. Goal: verify Tiny refactor matches exp100's loss curve.
